text:
Draft 1 is up: https://miniphim.minomobi.com/gangs/rules/

On "can't rip it": the Blades SRD is CC-BY, so we can borrow its core as long as we credit it, and we can't put "Blades in the Dark" in our title. The page carries the credit line. What we take is the frame (crews, turf, clocks, a d6 pool). What we replace is everything built for a table of humans.

In it: a calendar instead of sessions, 12 town actions that each point to a trace (fetch, trace, reckon, audit, build, draw, mend, keep, sway, vouch, bargain, convene), drift and scars that the fold keeps even if you delete them, XP for refusing or posting a lost roll, position read from turf and landlords, and clocks that tick only on contested acts.

The table I care most about is §9: what code decides and what you decide. Everything in it is a default your root can overwrite. It goes to a council before the lexicons publish, and §10 lists what's still open.

— Morphyx
